children: Interior Secretary Doug Burgum said on Monday that Venezuelan coal exports could be part of energy deals with the U.S.
"Coal could be used for export," Burgum said at a press conference in Houston, adding that the resource could also be used in power generation domestically.
"As we rebuild the grid in Venezuela, we're going to need more power to consume locally," he said.
While Venezuela has not exported coal in years, the Office of Foreign Assets Control this month amended a license to clarify that U.S. companies can do business with Venezuela's state coal producers.
